jobs.description: The Company: Outschool’s mission is to inspire kids to love learning. In our fast-changing world, the traditional educational system struggles to meet the diverse and evolving needs of young learners. Outschool reimagines this system, offering flexible and engaging learning experiences as a supplement and alternative to traditional education. By connecting learners with a global community of teachers and peers through our online platform, we make learning personal, dynamic, and deeply human. We've made significant strides since launching our marketplace of live online classes in 2017. Finding initial success with secular homeschoolers, we then expanded to enrichment learning to meet the needs of a wider audience, growing our business 16x since 2019. Post-pandemic, we have evolved our platform to power academic learning, incorporated AI, and have begun to grow our international community. We're proud to have served over 1.5M passionate learners with more than $100M in annual bookings.   Driving disruptive, positive change in education is rewarding and hard. Outschool team members are encouraged to challenge themselves, take risks, and grow in their careers. We look for talented people whose sense of urgency, innate curiosity, and determination to drive impact will help Outschool achieve outsized results in pursuit of our mission. We invite you to be part of an ambitious team dedicated to ensuring every learner can navigate the future with curiosity, resilience, and a love of learning. The Role Outschool is hiring a Director of Infrastructure Engineering to lead our Infrastructure and Platform team, whose mission is to accelerate innovation and deliver operation stability through a combination of robust infrastructure, principled platformization, and empowering DevX. You'll own hard problems, from deep-diving into a full infrastructure stack, to up-leveling DevX, to establishing automations, to hardening security, to evolving systems to be AI-native, to developing platform components. You will succeed with both strong organizational and people leadership skills, as well as exceptional hands-on development skills. You might be a great fit for this role if: You are a deep infrastructure expert familiar with all common modern infra technologies, and you thrive in diving into details You understand platformization, and have deep experience building platform components that are principled, efficient, usable, and maintainable You have experience as an engineering manager in a fast-paced startup or growth-stage company, and enjoy supporting teams through change and scale, including managing engineers across multiple sites You bring strong technical judgment and a track record of leading engineering teams that ship impactful systems quickly and iteratively You’re passionate about education, access, and user experience, and motivated by a mission-driven environment You enjoy balancing technical decision-making with coaching, and you’re committed to building inclusive, high-performing teams You excel at owning and driving engineering roadmaps; collaborating with cross-functional partners to prioritize initiatives, align with business objectives, and ensure timely, high-quality execution Core Responsibilities: Lead, mentor and grow a multi-site team of 5-10 engineers while remaining hands-on with architecture, technical direction, as well as day-to-day development Establish both short-term deliverables and long-term strategies across Outschool’s entire Infrastructure stack, including identifying and investing into opportunities for infra upgrade, platformization, and AI enablement as appropriate Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Data, Marketing and Operations to deliver an exceptional systems and experiences Partner with senior leadership to align on strategy, metrics and priorities Champion technical excellence and a culture of high ownership, providing mentorship, feedback, and support for the professional growth of engineers on your team Drive adoption of AI-development principles and agentic engineering workflows across the team Desired Experience & Skills: 10+ years of software engineering experience 5+ years of engineering management experience leading medium-sized teams, with demonstrated proficiency in performance management, career development, and people logistics Strong background in infrastructure and platform engineering, including deep expertise with AWS, Postgres, Kubernetes, Redshift, Terraform, Cloudwatch, and more Familiar with AI-native development paradigms and understands how to take teams through AI transformations Demonstrated ability to oversee multiple parallel projects from planning to execution and on time delivery Ability to align team goals with business objectives and contribute to strategic planning Experience in recruiting, hiring, and onboarding software engineers Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, both written and verbal Other Considerations: Experience in EdTech or building products for learners, educators, or families Experience with infrastructure upgrades, migrations, and consolidations Background in marketplace technologies Experience at a fast-paced startup or high-growth company Compensation: Outschool recruits across the US and Canada, and sets employee salaries to reflect local compensation and cost of living. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for equity and benefits. Additional details are provided during the interview process. For Canadian-based candidates, compensation range for this role is $220,000 - $275,000 CAD annually. This role is available in the following US Pay Zones: US Tiers US Tier 1: San Francisco Bay Area, New York City, and Seattle Metro US Tier 2: All California excluding San Francisco Bay Area, Boston Metro, Chicago Metro, Denver Metro, Austin Metro, Portland Metro US Tier 3: All other cities and states US Pay Zones US Tier 1: $260,000 - $357,500 US Tier 2: $221,000 - $303,875 US Tier 3: $195,000 - $268,125 Benefits & Culture: At Outschool, we believe that taking care of one another enables us to do our best work. To us that means: Shared Financial Success: Competitive salaries, stock options, and retirement plans Health: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance Wellness: Annual wellness stipend, access to coaching & therapy, and pet wellness plans PTO & Family Benefits: Generous PTO and family leave policies Hybrid & Remote-Friendly: Outschool has a distributed team across the U.S. and Canada and an office in San Francisco. Bay Area-based employees work in the office part of the week and receive commute-related benefits. Team members outside the Bay Area remain fully remote, with support for expensable home office setup and internet to stay connected no matter where you are. Lifelong Learners: Annual budgets for professional development and DEI learning; budgets for children to take Outschool classes Community Impact: Outschool matches employee donations to eligible charities and supports Outschool.org’s nonprofit programs Outschool is an equal opportunity employer. We view diversity as a moral imperative and competitive advantage. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We plan and structure our interviews to directly assess skills and experience.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact recruiting@outschool.com .   Benefits packages are included for full-time employees only. Please note benefits and perks may vary for employees based outside of the US and Canada.   Full-time employees must be a citizen or legal residents of the U.S. or Canada and reside in U.S. or Canada, unless specifically indicated otherwise.    Once you submit your application, Outschool will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy for employment. Unless specifically indicated otherwise, we hire employees only in the U.S. and Canada. Applicants else where should be aware that we may discard your application upon submission or we may ask if you would like us to retain it later should there be consideration (this is not typical at all).  If you are selected for interviewing, your data will be shared with interviewers and personnel involved in that process. If not hired, your application will be retained for one year in case there is another suitable role. You may opt out of this at any time. Please see our Employee/Applicant Privacy Notice  for more detailed information. If applicable, as you progress through the process, we will be clear about what information is being asked for and what happens with that information.

The Role Outschool is on a path to become the leading Education Savings Account (ESA) platform in the country. Over the past few years we built the operations and systems that made that growth possible — entering new funding marketplaces, standing up reimbursement, and serving families across a fast-growing set of state programs. As the public-funding program matures from building new systems to running and scaling them, we’re creating this role to be the connective tissue that keeps it all moving — and continually makes it run better and scale. The Public Funding Project Lead leads cross-functional execution across Customer Experience, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product — turning strategy into coordinated, on-time delivery for launches, new-program onboarding, and reimbursement expansion. Just as importantly, you’ll be our internal expert on the ESA family: the person who lives and breathes the persona and makes sure everything we ship reflects how these families actually navigate their funding. You’ll also lead our push to use AI to work faster and more efficiently, turning manual processes into scalable automations.  As the program’s work distributes to teams across the company, you’ll be the point person who keeps a multi-team effort aligned, spots risks before they become problems, brings deep ESA expertise to bear on our strategy, and raises the bar on how we execute. Build trusted working relationships with the owners in each function — CX, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Product — well enough to understand their real constraints and broker tradeoffs. Act as Outschool’s internal ESA-family expert, bringing the lived persona into product, go-to-market, and support decisions, and pressure-testing our messaging and experience before it reaches families. Own the project-management systems and operating cadence for the public-funding program — roadmaps, dependencies, status tracking, and clear decision-making across teams. Drive and coordinate AI-enabled efficiency — identify and (with engineering as needed) build automations such as order-fulfillment and invoicing workflows that reduce manual effort and help the program scale. Continuously look for ways to improve and scale ESA operations — spotting inefficiencies and bottlenecks, streamlining and automating workflows, and building processes that hold up as volume grows. Keep our distributed operating model coordinated: ensure the teams that own individual pieces of public funding stay aligned, and proactively surface and resolve risks. Partner with the Partnerships Lead to coordinate the internal execution of partner-driven launches, keeping Product, CX, Legal, and Finance aligned as new partners and programs come online. Desired Experience & Skills: Proven project or program management experience leading cross-functional initiatives to on-time, on-budget delivery. A track record of acting as a trusted partner across functions — not just tracking a plan, but building enough credibility with each team that they bring you problems early. Comfortable working through disagreement: can surface competing priorities between teams, facilitate toward a decision, and communicate tradeoffs and risks to stakeholders clearly, even without formal authority. Strong operational and process orientation, with the ability to turn ambiguous, fast-changing requirements into clear, repeatable workflows. The Company 아웃스쿨의 미션은 아이들이 배움에 대한 사랑을 키우도록 영감을 주는 것입니다. 빠르게 변화하는 세상 속에서 전통적인 교육 시스템은 어린 학습자들의 다양하고 끊임없이 변화하는 요구를 충족하는 데 어려움을 겪고 있습니다. 아웃스쿨은 이러한 시스템을 새롭게 상상하며, 전통 교육을 보완하거나 대체할 수 있는 유연하고 몰입도 높은 학습 경험을 제공합니다. 온라인 플랫폼을 통해 학습자들을 전 세계의 교사 및 또래 커뮤니티와 연결함으로써, 우리는 배움을 개인적이고 역동적이며 깊이 인간적인 경험으로 만듭니다. 2017년 실시간 온라인 수업 마켓플레이스를 출시한 이후, 우리는 의미 있는 성장을 이루어 왔습니다. 세속적 홈스쿨링 가정에서 초기 성공을 거둔 뒤, 더 넓은 학습자층의 요구를 충족하기 위해 심화·확장 학습 분야로 확장했으며, 2019년 이후 비즈니스를 16배 성장시켰습니다. 팬데믹 이후에는 학업 학습을 지원하도록 플랫폼을 발전시키고, AI를 도입했으며, 국제 커뮤니티를 성장시키기 시작했습니다. 우리는 100만 명 이상의 열정적인 학습자에게 서비스를 제공하고, 연간 예약액 1억 달러 이상을 달성한 것을 자랑스럽게 생각합니다. 교육 분야에서 혁신적이고 긍정적인 변화를 이끄는 일은 보람 있지만 쉽지 않습니다. 아웃스쿨의 팀원들은 스스로에게 도전하고, 위험을 감수하며, 커리어에서 성장하도록 장려받습니다. 우리는 긴박감, 타고난 호기심, 그리고 영향력을 만들어내려는 결단력을 바탕으로 아웃스쿨이 미션을 추구하는 과정에서 뛰어난 성과를 달성하도록 도울 수 있는 인재를 찾고 있습니다. 모든 학습자가 호기심, 회복탄력성, 배움에 대한 사랑을 가지고 미래를 헤쳐 나갈 수 있도록 헌신하는 야심 찬 팀의 일원이 되어 주시기를 초대합니다. The Role We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure to join our Infrastructure and Platform team. The team’s mission is to accelerate innovation and deliver operation stability through a combination of robust infrastructure, principled platformization, and empowering DevX. You'll own hard problems, from deep-diving into a full infrastructure stack, to upleveling DevX, to establishing automations, to hardening security, to evolving systems to be AI-native, to developing platform components and integrations. We are an effective team of engineers distributed across the US, Canada, and South Korea. Our philosophy is to start small and then intentionally iterate to test our assumptions and learn quickly. We're iteratively building up a complex product for a highly engaged audience. This role requires working in our Haeundae, Busan, South Korea office, Tuesday-Friday from 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM (Monday, remote). 저희는 인프라 및 플랫폼 팀에 합류할 시니어 소프트웨어 엔지니어, 인프라를 찾고 있습니다. 핵심 인프라 팀의 미션은 개발자들이 신뢰할 수 있고, 안전하며, 마찰 없는 시스템을 통해 혁신을 가속화하고 운영 안정성을 보장할 수 있도록 지원하는 것입니다. 이 역할에서는 개발자 경험, 자동화, 보안 강화, 그리고 시스템을 AI 네이티브로 발전시키는 일 등 어려운 문제들을 주도하게 됩니다. 저희는 미국, 캐나다, 한국에 분산되어 있는 효율적인 엔지니어 팀입니다. 저희의 철학은 작게 시작한 뒤, 가설을 검증하고 빠르게 학습하기 위해 의도적으로 반복 개선해 나가는 것입니다. 우리는 참여도가 매우 높은 고객층을 위해 복잡한 제품을 단계적으로 구축해 나가고 있습니다. 이 역할은 대한민국 부산 해운대 오피스에서 화요일부터 금요일까지 오전 7시부터 오후 3시까지 근무해야 합니다. Our Stack : Infrastructure & Platform:  AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, VPC, IAM) · Terraform · GitLab · Prometheus/Grafana · OpenTelemetry Product Layer TypeScript · Node · React · GraphQL · PostgreSQL · OpenSearch You won't own this code but you'll own the systems that let engineers ship it with confidence. AI-Native The team uses AI throughout the development workflow.  We're actively building infrastructure for AI/ML workloads in production — experimentation pipelines, model serving, and observability.  기술 스택: 인프라 및 플랫폼: AWS(EKS, RDS, S3, Lambda, VPC, IAM) · Terraform · GitLab · Prometheus/Grafana · OpenTelemetry 제품 레이어: TypeScript · Node · React · GraphQL · PostgreSQL · OpenSearch 이 코드들을 직접 소유하게 되지는 않지만, 엔지니어들이 자신 있게 배포할 수 있도록 하는 시스템을 책임지게 됩니다. AI 네이티브: 팀은 개발 워크플로 전반에서 AI를 활용하고 있습니다. 또한 프로덕션 환경에서 AI/ML 워크로드를 운영하기 위한 인프라를 적극적으로 구축하고 있습니다 — 실험 파이프라인, 모델 서빙, 관측 가능성까지 포함합니다. Core Responsibilities: Developer experience: Define and drive the Developer Experience strategy for a 10-20 person engineering org. Improve tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and internal developer platforms so engineers ship faster and with more confidence. Automation: Design and implement automation for provisioning, monitoring, deployment, and operational workflows. Reduce toil. Build systems that run themselves. Security: Harden infrastructure across the stack. Implement security best practices at the platform level. Partner with engineering to embed security into the development lifecycle. AI-forward infrastructure: Help evolve our platform to natively support AI/ML workloads. Think infrastructure that enables experimentation, scales AI features to production, and supports a team that uses AI as a first-class tool. Reliability: Own production systems. Build observability into everything. Set the reliability bar and on-call culture for the engineering org. Participate in on-call and lead incident response with a systems-thinking mindset. Product support: Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript to be able to directly contribute to backend product development, APIs, data services, and application architecture as needed. Platformization: Develop shared platforms and / or integrate with external services in a way that’s clean, principled, extensible, and maintainable 핵심 책임: 개발자 경험: 10~20명 규모의 엔지니어링 조직을 위한 개발자 경험 전략을 정의하고 추진합니다. 엔지니어들이 더 빠르고 더 자신 있게 배포할 수 있도록 툴링, CI/CD 파이프라인, 내부 개발자 플랫폼을 개선합니다. 자동화: 프로비저닝, 모니터링, 배포, 운영 워크플로를 위한 자동화를 설계하고 구현합니다. 반복적이고 수동적인 업무를 줄이고, 스스로 운영되는 시스템을 구축합니다. 보안: 스택 전반의 인프라를 강화합니다. 플랫폼 수준에서 보안 모범 사례를 구현합니다. 엔지니어링 팀과 협력하여 개발 라이프사이클 전반에 보안을 내재화합니다.
